moves.why: First move in a 2-player, 6-bore game. Small puck on bore 0 claims the 2-point floor while leaving the shelf open; opponent can still slot a large above it but at least I have the better tier locked.
taking a shelf now for 1 point while the floor option is denied this turn (seat 0 just claimed bore 0 floor); mirroring structure across the board

Bore 0's shelf is still open — opponent could drop a large on it to bury my floor for 1 point total. I should seal that threat now with my own large on bore 0... actually let me check: large on bore 0 would seal it (my shelf point) and bury my own floor. Net: +1 shelf, lose 0 floor value since it's mine already. That denies opponent a shelf point too. Hmm but option 0 is exactly that. Let me pick option 0.

seat 0 has only 1 small left; I should take floor on a bore they can't easily answer — bore 0 floor is already theirs so it's off-limits. Bore 2 floor is open and they'd need 2 more turn cycles to threaten it, but better I take a floor now for 2 points since they're converting fast
Floor on bore 2 for 2 points. Bore 1's shelf and floor are opponent's, no point going there. I have 1 small left and 3 large. Flooring now builds the lead.
seat 0 has run out of smalls (0 remaining) and will be forced to play large next turn, sealing shelves for 1 point. I should grab a floor now on bore 4 before they catch up

Bore 2: my floor is on the bottom, opponent could put a large on it later (would bury my 2-pt floor for a 1-pt shelf). Sealing my own bore 2 with large gives me +1 shelf and denies opponent a shelf point. Good defensive seal.
only one open floor left (bore 5); I have 2 smalls remaining and seat 0 has 2 larges. I must take that floor now while I can — it's 2 points and seat 0 cannot contest it

Bore 3 has my floor on bottom and open shelf above. If I seal with large, I get +1 shelf and protect my floor. Two remaining bores (4,5) opponent has floors — opponent will seal those with their last large, getting shelves there. Match those shelves by sealing mine too.

both bores 4 and 5 have my floor and seat 0 has no smalls left. Sealing their shelf denies seat 0 a point on bore 4 (matching theirs elsewhere). Either shelf gives 1 point; bore 4 takes a bore adjacent to my existing floor cluster
Only legal move. Seals bore 5 (opponent's floor gets buried, I get shelf point). Final scoring: me 8+1=9 on bore 5, opponent will seal elsewhere or the game ends. Forced.
